objective: Assess recurring unit economics for fictional Pond Exchange under a growth review.

sources.title: Operations reconciliation
sources.extract: Pond Exchange Ltd recorded USD 1,000,000 placed-order GMV before cancellations and refunds. Settled GMV was USD 700,000. Recognised fees were USD 70,000. Cohort retention and post-incentive contribution were absent.

sources.title: Founder announcement
sources.extract: Founder describes placed-order GMV as USD 1,000,000 of company revenue and reports a 7% fee-to-placed-GMV ratio.

sources.title: Trade outlet reprint
sources.extract: The outlet reprints the company announcement with no independent verification or additional source.

questions.question: Give recognised fees in whole USD.
Give recognised fees divided by settled GMV as a percentage number.
Classify the $1,000,000 company revenue claim as supported, contradicted, different_basis, or unknown.
Compared with settled-GMV take rate, classify the founder's 7% placed-GMV ratio as supported, contradicted, different_basis, or unknown.
How many source origins independent of Pond corroborate recognised fees in this packet?

priority_options.COHORT: Buyer and seller cohorts and repeat settled activity.
priority_options.CONTRIBUTION: Transactions reconciled to incentives, refunds and contribution.
